english.title: Interfere with equipment on the Transport for London regional railway network
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) whilst upon the Transport for London regional railway network

(A)_[moved]_
(B)_[attempted to move]_
(C)_[operated]_
(D)_[attempted to operate]_
(E)_[obstructed]_
(F)_[attempted to obstruct]_
(G)_[stopped]_
(H)_[attempted to stop]_
(I)_[interfered with]_
(J)_[attempted to interfere with]_

(K)_[a train]_
(L)_[railway equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE EQUIPMENT..)]_

other than in an emergency by means of equipment on or near which was a notice indicating that it was intended to be used in an emergency or by using any equipment intended for the use of passengers in that way in normal operating circumstances
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 11(1) and 23 of the Transport for London Railway Byelaws made under paragraph 26 of Schedule 11 to the Greater London Authority Act 1999 and confirmed under section 67 of the Transport Act 1962.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Byelaw 22 for the provision of a name and address by persons suspected of breaching this byelaw.
(ii) See byelaw 24 for a power to remove persons breaching this byelaw
(iii) See byelaw 25 for the requirement for authorised persons exercising any power conferred any of the Byelaws to produce a form of identification when requested to do so.
(iv) See byelaw 26 in relation to notices displayed.
(v) See byelaw 27 for the liability of authorised person acting in the course of his duties.
